meta.label: Old-age dependency ratio, by NUTS 3 region (2022)
meta.methodNote: People aged 65+ as a percentage of the working-age (15-64) population, per NUTS 3 region (province-equivalent), OECD's Regional Statistics database (DSD_REG_DEMO@DF_DEPEND, MEASURE=DEPEND_RATIO, AGE=Y_GE65, UNIT_MEASURE=PT_POP_Y15T64), 2022 — the newest year before a 2023 coverage drop, and the finest grain of any layer in this batch (NUTS 3, matching homicide and vehicle theft rather than the NUTS 2 layers). A structurally different signal from every existing age layer: the Italy map's median-age and indice-di-vecchiaia layers describe a comune's age profile directly; this describes the working-age population's support burden, the figure that actually predicts strain on local services.
meta.coverageNote: Albania has ZERO codes (not an OECD member). Italy has FULL 107/107 NUTS 3 coverage — the only layer in this batch with no Italy-specific gap at all. The UK and France both have partial coverage; checked independently rather than assumed to match another layer's shape.
